name: Constellation
tagline: A web IDE where you describe a research goal and an agent builds, runs and debugs parallel cloud workflows.

awards: First Place for NorthMark Compute & Cloud Challenge

problem: Researchers need large-scale compute but lack the CS background.
solution: Users upload data and describe goals; an agentic assistant builds a visual execution graph, deploys tasks to cloud batch services and debugs failures.
demo_moment: Team-described: autopilot debugging of a failing parallel job.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “First Place for NorthMark Compute & Cloud Challenge” among 176 submissions.

lessons: Visualise the execution graph so non-experts trust the run.
